The Pharmacy Manager provides leadership to promote effective formulary management for the organization through evidence-based medication selection, cost containment strategies, and implementation of safe and effective therapeutic alternatives. The manager represents the department and medical center on committees and task forces related to these programs including but not limited to the Pharmacy & Therapeutics Committee, and related subcommittees and task forces. This individual works with and manages pharmacy personnel who conduct the day-to-day activities that support medication policy, formulary management and drug shortage programs. The manager is responsible for supervision, staff development and assessment of staff competency. Additional responsibilities include assisting the Associate Chief Pharmacy Officer and other members of the pharmacy management team with planning, implementing and monitoring new programs, processes and technologies that enhance medication use systems, optimize patient outcomes, control drug expenses and maintain compliance with regulatory standards and formulary best practices. #CA-DS
